RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the December 17, 2002/Agrahayana 26, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Finance and Company Affairs; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism and Culture; Water Resources)
Total number of questions—20
115
Tourism Projects in Rajasthan
*381. DR. ABRAR AHMED: Will the
Minister of TOURISM AND CULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that out of 237
projects sanctioned for the  development of
infrastructure in the field of tourism since
2001, only 4 projects have been sanctioned
for Rajasthan;
(b) if so, the names of the projects
sanctioned for Rajasthan;
(c) the amount spent on each of the
projects so far; and
(d) by when the projects are likely to be
completed?
Higher interest rates in RRBs
*382. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of FINANCE AND
COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that interest rates
in Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) are higher
than those of commercial banks; and
(b) if so, the action proposed to take up
the right type of restructuring plan for
RRBs?
Indo-Italian Co-operation Programme
in H.P.
*383. SHRI  ANIL SHARMA: Will
the Minister of FINANCE AND
COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) what are the details of the proposals
for bilateral assistance under the Indo-Italian
Development Co-operation Programme
received from Himachal Pradesh
Government;
(b) what are the main objectives of the
project; and
(c) what action Government have taken/
propose to take in the matter and by when?
Restriction on creation of new posts in
Government services
*384. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of FINANCE AND
COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken the
decision of restricting the creation of new
posts in Government services as well as in
the services of Government undertakings;
(b) the extent of progress made in the
execution of  Voluntary Retirement Scheme;
and

116
WIN2\SESSION\6361RS-QUES 116
(c) the reasons for encouraging the
employees for taking Voluntary Retirement
Scheme?
Inspection of Central and State Co-
operative Banks by NABARD
*385. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of FINANCE AND COMPANY
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether NABARD has conducted
statutory inspection under Section 35 of the
RBI Act in regard to Central and State
Cooperative Banks;
(b) if so, the details of the irregularities
noticed by NABARD; and
(c) whether NABARD has further taken
any action in this regard and if so, the  details
thereof?
Multiple tax system
*386. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
SHRI BHAGATRAM MANHAR:
Will the Minister of FINANCE AND
COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
multiple tax system and several other levies
are cramping the growth of industrial sector
in the country;
(b) if so, whether Government are
contemplating to enact a law on ending
multiple taxes, regulation and standards; and
(c) if so, what are the details in this
regard?
Demat Share Scam
*387. SHRI JIBON ROY: Will the
Minister of FINANCE AND COMPANY
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an official
complaint has been lodged with SEBI to
probe into Demat Share Scam;
(b) if so, what is Government's reaction
thereto; and
(c) whether Government propose to
issue a White Paper on this scam?
Surplus in the current account of
Government
*388. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY :
 Will the Minister of FINANCE AND
COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether surplus in the current
account of Government was recorded in
2001-2002 for the first time in 24 years;
(b) if so, what is the total surplus during
the current year;
(c) whether there has been any further
improvement uptil now; and
(d) what efforts are being made to have
a further surplus in the current account
during the remaining period of the current
financial year?
Increase in price of Natural Gas
*389. SHRI BACHANI LEKHRAJ:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to increase the price of natural gas after
1st April, 2003;
(b) if so, by when and how much and
the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether Government of Gujarat have
made any representation to the Central
Government not to hike gas prices, if so,
what decision has been taken?

117
WIN2\SESSION\6361RS-QUES 117
National Level Regulatory Board for
SFCs
*390. SHRI GAYA SINGH: Will the
Minister of FINANCE AND COMPANY
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to form
a permanent National Level Committee/
Regulatory Board to look after the
functioning of State Financial Corporations,
to make them free from influential persons,
to have uniformity in their functioning and
to provide them the guidance from one point
instead of triangular points;
(b) if so, what will be the composition
of that Board and by when it will be formed;
and
(c) if not, what are the reasons therefor?

Tiruchirapalli as an international
airport
2669. SHRI P. G. NARAYANAN: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are having any
proposal to fulfil the repeated assurance of
making Tiruchirapalli an international
airport;
(b) if so, the details of action taken
to meet its infrastructural requirements;
and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Direct flights between Hyderabad and
London
2670. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether British Airways is
contemplating to operate direct flights
from Hyderabad to London in near future;
and
(b) the number of flights British Airways
is operating from India at present with places
from where they originate together with the
details thereof?
Appointment of Traffic Assistants in
IA
2671. SHRI RAMA SHANKER
KAUSHIK: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the number and names of persons
appointed as Traffic Assistants in Indian
Airlines on the basis of recommendations
from Ministers and high officials;
(b) whether any inquiry has been
conducted against such matter;
(c) if so, the details thereof with its
outcome; and
(d) if not, by when the inquiry report is
likely to be presented?
Runway at Madurai Airport
2672. SHRI S. AGNIRAJ:
SHRI R. SHUNMUGA-
SUNDARAM:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the reasons for the delay in extending
and improving the runway at Madurai
Airport; and
(b) whether there is any proposal to
increase the number of flights touching
Madurai as it is the Southern most airport in
India?

587
WIN2\SESSION\6362RS-QUES 587
Scanning machines at airports
2673. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether high quality scanning of
baggages at all the airports of the country
has become imperative keeping in view
security hazards;
(b) if so, what steps have been taken in
this regard during the last three years;
(c) whether the machines provided at all
airports are defective and remain out of order
most of the time and are of a lower quality;
(d) if so, the details in this regard;
(e) whether the scanning machines
provided at various airports meet the desired
standards;
(f) if not, the reasons therefor and what
steps are being taken to rectify the
deficiencies and improve the standards; and
(g) if not, the reasons therefor?
Closure of Jharsuguda airstrip
2674. SHRIMATI SUSHREE DEVI:
SHRI B. J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to close down
the airstrip at Jharsuguda in Orissa; if so,
the reasons therefor;
(b) whether this will cause
inconvenience to the passengers of  Western
Orissa, as this area has been surrounded
with large private sector units; and
(c) whether it is feasible to renovate,
upgrade or modernize the airstrip rather than
closing it; if so, the details thereof?
Violation of  airlines rules
2675. SHRI H. K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that airlines bend
rules to benefit Minister's wife as reported
in the Indian Express dated the 15th August,
2002; if so, the reasons therefor;
(b) the details of the persons, who got
benefited under the amended airlines rules
during the last three years;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
amended rules have insulted the senior Air
Hostesses and caused unrest in the mind of
seniors; and
(d) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to set right the things?
Study on aircraft requirement
2676. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that around 400
aircrafts would be needed over the next
twenty years;
(b) if so, whether any study has been
made in this regard; and
(c) what will be the likely cost of the
aircrafts and Government's share therein?
Competition of IA with private
companies
2677. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian Airlines
is facing tough competition from private
companies like Air Sahara;

588
WIN2\SESSION\6362RS-QUES 588
(b) whether Government are aware that
Air Sahara is likely to add 22 new aircrafts
to its fleet;
(c) whether Government are aware that
the private airlines are giving better services
and comforts to their passengers; and
(d) if so, what steps are being taken to
streamline the working of Indian Airlines to
enable it perform at economically viable level
while competing with private airlines?
International services from Madurai
